input.title: Prepare the guest room
input.description: Guests arrive Friday. Clean the room, wash bedding and set out towels.

plan.summary: Prepare the guest room for arrival: clean surfaces, wash bedding, and set out fresh towels.

steps.title: Gather supplies
steps.description: Collect a microfiber cloth, mild all‑purpose cleaner, vacuum or broom, laundry detergent, fresh towels, and clean bedding.

steps.title: Clean room surfaces
steps.description: Wipe down all surfaces (bedside tables, dresser, windowsills) with the cleaner, vacuum or sweep the floor, and dust any visible spots.

steps.title: Wash bedding
steps.description: Remove old sheets and pillowcases, wash them in hot water with detergent, and dry completely before reassembling.

steps.title: Set out towels and bedding
steps.description: Place fresh towels on the dresser or hook, arrange clean sheets on the bed, and add a decorative pillow or two for a welcoming touch.

cautions: Avoid harsh chemicals that can damage surfaces or fabrics.
Ensure bedding is fully dry before placing it on the bed.
